description: The user's profile for forms: name, headline, company, role, location, linkedin, x, github, website, telegram, instagram, bio (a sentence), about (a paragraph). With no set, returns what is kept. set: {key: value} writes those keys (an empty value clears one). Fill it from the user's own pages (their LinkedIn, X or GitHub profile, their site) when a form needs it or the user asks; never guess, and never put secrets, ids or money in it.

source.description: Where the values came from: LinkedIn, their site, GitHub, X, memory

name: profile
title: Profile for Forms
